description: This file defines an abstract class RenderElement in the Drupal core rendering system, which extends RenderElementBase and provides deprecated methods for render element plugins.

classes.name: RenderElement
classes.description: An abstract class providing a deprecated base for render element plugins in Drupal, extending RenderElementBase.
